<P STYLE="text-align: right; margin: 0">Exhibit 99.1</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="border-collapse: collapse; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%">
<TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: left">
  <TD STYLE="width: 75%"><P STYLE="margin: 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 14pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 130.5pt 0pt 0"><B>American
Fusion Inc. (OTC: AMFN) Announces Initial Revenue-Generating Transaction Supporting Canadian Department of National Defence Requirement</B></P>
&nbsp;</TD>
  <TD STYLE="text-align: right; width: 25%; vertical-align: middle"><IMG SRC="image_001.jpg" ALT="" STYLE="height: 123px; width: 123px"><BR></TD></TR>
<TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: left">
  <TD COLSPAN="2" STYLE="text-align: right; vertical-align: bottom"><FONT STYLE="color: #1504B8"><B>Leader in Scalable Compact Fusion
  Energy</B></FONT></TD></TR>
<TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: left">
  <TD COLSPAN="2" STYLE="border-bottom: Black 1pt solid; padding-bottom: 1pt; text-align: right; vertical-align: bottom">&nbsp;</TD></TR>
</TABLE>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: right"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; font-size: 9pt; color: #0F4761"><B><I></I></B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Southlake, Texas &ndash; April 28, 2026 &ndash; American Fusion
Inc. (OTC: AMFN) (&ldquo;American Fusion&rdquo; or the &ldquo;Company&rdquo;), an advanced energy platform company focused on fusion technologies
and strategic institutional market opportunities, announced that it has received a purchase order from Effective Acceleration Ventures
Ltd. (&ldquo;EAV&rdquo;) to act as a United States source-of-supply provider for specialized instrumentation supporting a Canadian Department
of National Defence (&ldquo;DND&rdquo;) / Quality Engineering Test Establishment (&ldquo;QETE&rdquo;) requirement.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">This transaction represents the Company&rsquo;s first revenue-generating
activity and supports its broader strategy to participate in government, defense, and institutional procurement markets.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>Transaction Overview</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">&bull;</TD><TD>AMFN Role: U.S. Source-of-Supply Vendor</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">&bull;</TD><TD>Prime Contractor: Effective Acceleration Ventures Ltd. (EAV)</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">&bull;</TD><TD>End User: Canadian Department of National Defence / QETE</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">&bull;</TD><TD>Equipment: Two (2) 53100A Phase Noise Analyzer units (Microchip Technology Inc. OEM)</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">&bull;</TD><TD>Purchase Order Value: Approximately $58,000 (excluding shipping and related pass-through costs)</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">&bull;</TD><TD>Contract Reference: DND Contract W8486-260222/A</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font: 12pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Under the structure, EAV serves as the Canadian prime contractor,
while American Fusion provides compliant U.S.-based sourcing for OEM instrumentation delivered to DND/QETE in Gatineau, Quebec.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>Strategic Significance</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">While modest in initial size, the transaction is strategically
meaningful:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">&bull;</TD><TD>Represents the Company&rsquo;s first revenue-generating transaction</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">&bull;</TD><TD>Supports expansion into government procurement channels</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">&bull;</TD><TD>Demonstrates capability to participate in defense and institutional supply chains</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">&bull;</TD><TD>May provide a foundation for additional opportunities in related markets</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font: 12pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">The equipment supplied is a high-precision phase noise analyzer
used in advanced RF signal analysis, frequency stability measurement, and oscillator characterization, with applications across defense,
aerospace, communications, and high-performance electronics systems.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width: 100%"><tr><td style="text-align: center; width: 100%">&#160;</td></tr></table></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt"><table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width: 100%"><tr><td style="text-align: center; width: 100%">&#160;</td></tr></table></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">This transaction is not expected to be material to the Company&rsquo;s
financial statements by itself, but management views it as significant as an initial commercial transaction consistent with the Company&rsquo;s
broader institutional market strategy.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Brent Nelson, Founder and Executive Director of American Fusion,
stated, &ldquo;This is an important milestone for American Fusion as it represents our first revenue transaction and demonstrates our
ability to participate in real-world procurement environments. We believe engagements of this type can support the development of broader
commercial relationships over time.&rdquo;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Richard Hawkins, CEO of American Fusion, added, &ldquo;This transaction
is an important proof point for our strategy. While our long-term focus remains fusion energy and advanced infrastructure, adjacent technical
supply chains such as precision instrumentation and RF systems allow us to establish relationships, credibility, and execution capability
within government and institutional markets today.&rdquo;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>Government Procurement Alignment</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">The transaction was facilitated with the support of Samuel Reid,
American Fusion&rsquo;s Government Strategy and Procurement Advisor, who brings experience in defense procurement and NATO-related supply
chains.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&ldquo;This transaction demonstrates how American Fusion can integrate
into existing government procurement frameworks,&rdquo; said Reid. &ldquo;By aligning with prime contractors and institutional buyers,
the Company is building a pathway into defense, Department of Energy, and NATO-related opportunities where both technical capability and
execution matter.&rdquo;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>Building a Revenue Platform Alongside Fusion Development</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">American Fusion&rsquo;s broader strategy is to build a multi-channel
revenue platform that supports:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">&bull;</TD><TD>Near-term revenue generation through government and institutional procurement</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">&bull;</TD><TD>Long-term value creation through fusion energy commercialization</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">&bull;</TD><TD>Strategic positioning within defense, energy, and infrastructure ecosystems</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font: 12pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">This approach enables the Company to generate revenue while advancing
its core fusion technology roadmap, including development of the Texatron&trade; aneutronic fusion platform..</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">For more information about Kepler Fusion Technologies and its Texatron&trade;
platform, please visit: www.keplerfusion.com and americanfusionenergy.com</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>About American Fusion Inc.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">American Fusion Inc. (OTC: AMFN) formerly Renewal Fuels, Inc. (OTC:
RNWF), is an advanced energy platform company focused on the development and commercialization of fusion energy technologies through its
wholly owned subsidiary, Kepler Fusion Technologies. Following its previously announced merger with Kepler, the Company is has changed
its name and is operating under the American Fusion brand. The Company&rsquo;s strategy is centered on building a scalable, infrastructure-grade
fusion energy platform supported by proprietary technology, disciplined intellectual property development, and long-term commercial deployment
objectives. For more information about American Fusion, please visit: americanfusionenergy.com</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>About Kepler Fusion Technologies</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Kepler Fusion Technologies is an advanced energy technology company
developing the Texatron&trade; aneutronic fusion platform. Kepler&rsquo;s technology is designed to support modular, infrastructure-grade
deployment for industrial, commercial, and grid-constrained applications. The Company&rsquo;s development strategy emphasizes system-level
engineering, disciplined intellectual property protection, and scalable architectures intended to support long-term commercial operation.
Kepler Fusion Technologies operates as a wholly owned subsidiary of American Fusion Inc. (OTC: AMFN) For more information about Kepler
Fusion Technologies and its Texatron&trade; platform, please visit: www.keplerfusion.com</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt/115% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>
